spec_match.rationale: Blocks a real worker and asks three witnesses — worker-side observer, main-thread ping timing, and post-hoc entries — exactly the observability the feature adds.

interactive.rationale: Block and reset ran; ping-gap evidence rendered; the absent-entry witness reported honestly on this build.

edge_cases.rationale: The no-entry case (this build) is a first-class outcome, not an error.

conformance.rationale: 5/6 — the worker assertion honest-fails here (tracked on entry-types-here).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Live block measured via ping gaps; console clean.

accessibility.rationale: Controls named, timings textual, visible focus.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 screenshots captured and inspected. The ping-gap witness proves the stall even where the API cannot.
